'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Odesa strikes (2022–present)|Odesa strikes]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch a missile attack on the city of [[Odesa]], [[Ukraine]], for the second consecutive day, killing at least ten civilians, injuring dozens of others and damaging civilian infrastructure, including residential buildings. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/11/18/7485062/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')]
**[[Ukrainian energy crisis]], [[17 November 2024 Russian strikes on Ukraine]]
***Ukraine re-implements nationwide [[rolling blackout]]s primarily due to yesterday's destruction of energy infrastructure by [[Russia]]n airstrikes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-brings-back-long-rolling-power-cuts-after-major-russian-strike-2024-11-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[Hezbollah]] launches more than 100 missiles at [[Israel]], including [[Tel Aviv]], killing one person and injuring dozens of others. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/2-injured-as-hezbollah-fires-100-rockets-at-north-beirut-shuts-schools/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***Five people are killed and 24 others are injured in an Israeli [[airstrike]] on [[Zuqaq al-Blat]], [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/18/at-least-five-people-killed-in-israeli-strikes-on-lebanons-capital (Al Jazeera)]
***Hezbollah and Lebanon both agree to a [[United States]] proposal for a [[ceasefire]]. However, Israel has refused to comment. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanon-hezbollah-agree-us-proposal-ceasefire-with-israel-lebanese-official-says-2024-11-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Security forces raid a [[Lashkar-e-Islam]] hideout in the [[Tirah|Tirah Valley]] of [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], killing ten militants and injuring several others. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pakistani-security-forces-raid-militant-hideout-northwest-10-115976044 (ABC News)]
**A [[Pakistani Taliban]] ambush on a military convoy in [[Khyber district]], Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, kills eight soldiers and wounds three others. Several gunmen are also killed. Separately, seven police officers are kidnapped in [[Bannu]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/militants-kill-8-pakistani-soldiers-abduct-7-police-officers/7868502.html (Voice of America)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Three people are killed and another is injured when a [[land mine]], believed to have been planted by [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]], explodes on a highway between [[Afgooye]] and [[Wanlaweyn]] in [[Lower Shabelle]], [[Somalia]]. [https://garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/three-killed-one-injured-in-somalia-explosion (Garowe Online)]
*Twenty gang members are killed by security forces in the [[Gaza Strip]] after armed [[Looting|looters]] [[Hijacking|hijacked]] almost 100 trucks bringing aid for the [[Blockade of the Gaza Strip|ongoing famine]]. [https://amp.theguardian.com/world/2024/nov/18/armed-looters-hijack-almost-100-trucks-carrying-aid-supplies-into-gaza (The Guardian)]
